claim: The default function timeout is 3 seconds; you can adjust it in increments of 1 second up to a maximum of 900 seconds (15 minutes). For functions on Lambda Managed Instances, asynchronous invocations and event source mapping invocations (except Amazon MQ and Amazon DocumentDB) allow a maximum of 5,400 seconds (90 minutes).

qualifiers.condition: Lambda Managed Instances allow 5,400 seconds for asynchronous and most event source mapping invocations

evidence.quote: The default value for this setting is 3 seconds, but you can adjust this in increments of 1 second up to a maximum value of 900 seconds (15 minutes).

For functions using AWS Lambda Managed Instances, asynchronous invocations and event source mapping invocations (except Amazon MQ and Amazon DocumentDB) support a maximum allowed value of 5,400 seconds (90 minutes).
